## Why become a
Zoho CRM Plus Partner?

### Provide comprehensive solutions to your clients

Businesses need to do a lot more than track just sales. With the Zoho CRM Plus bundle, you can introduce your customers to an integrated and heavily customizable ecosystem that unifies sales, marketing, and customer support data to give a comprehensive view of every customer.

### Explore additional service opportunities

Partners have additional opportunities to generate revenue by providing ancillary services. The scope of these services can include requirement analysis, solution scoping, implementation, training, managed services, and continued product support services.

### Build a reliable revenue stream

A fixed percentage of the entire deal value, for every single closed deal, will be assigned back to you as Partner Earnings, helping you build a steady source of revenue.

### Unlock exclusive Partner benefits

Gain access to exclusive benefits for Zoho Partners, including the Partner portal, licenses for demos and complimentary use, early access to products and updates, and a dedicated manager.

### Benefit from Zoho's comprehensive resources for Partners

As a Zoho CRM Plus Consulting Partner, you will have access to a wide range of resources to help you succeed. This includes marketing, branding, and sales materials, as well as newsletters, webinars, and Partner events.

## What do we look for in our Partners?

Demonstrated experience implementing a customer experience management solution

A valid company registration and a website that accurately represents your business

An established business network to generate demand in the region where you intend to operate

A functional team with dedicated sales personnel and technical experts

Willingness to invest in Zoho training and certification to develop product and domain expertise
